description:
About the company
 Our client is a fast-growing insurance company.
 The role
 Raydar is recruiting for this role on behalf of our client. Own business metrics by building AI-powered software features across the full stack. Partner with non-technical teams to turn operational pain points into scalable solutions, working at a very fast pace and helping keep live systems healthy.
 What you'll do
 - Take ownership of one or more business metrics and drive measurable gains through new software features.
 - Work directly with sales, service and underwriting colleagues to understand problems and design scalable fixes.
 - Build and release AI agent systems and automation spanning user interfaces, services and data components.
 - Support live production systems as part of an on-call rotation.
 - Prototype, ship and iterate quickly, often within hours.
 Requirements 
 What we're looking for
 - 4+ years of software engineering experience.
 - A track record of launching LLM-based or agent-driven capabilities that are used by real customers in a live environment.
 - Daily hands-on use of AI-assisted coding tools.
 - Ability to design agent-based architectures, including retrieval and LLM orchestration.
 - Comfort delivering complete software solutions, from user interface through services to data and AI components.
 - Working knowledge of a major cloud platform such as AWS or GCP.
 - Ability to explain technical tradeoffs clearly to non-technical stakeholders and connect engineering work to business needs.
 Bonus points
 - Experience at a high-growth startup or a strong promotion track record at a fast-moving technology company.
 - Background in speech-based AI, low-latency systems, retrieval-based approaches or agent frameworks.
 Benefits 
 Compensation and benefits
 - Base salary: USD 180,000 to 280,000 per year
 - Equity
 Location and work model
 - San Francisco, CA, United States
 - On-site, 5 days per week in office
 - Full-time
